jobs.title: SG0142: Regional Financial Planning & Analysis Analyst-Senior
jobs.description:
You will play a major role in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) in evaluation and action recommendation, financial analysis, forecasting and budgeting, business partnering. This regional role will present opportunities to work with various departments to provide financial service and consultancy which support the management team in making strategic business decisions.
Key Responsibilities:
- Financial Forecasting: Provide consolidated outlooks for both revenue and expenses at monthly basis; identify business implications and partners with stakeholders to execute targeted action items; explore improvement of forecast modelling and approaches to better meet the dynamic needs of the business.

- Annual Budgeting: Partner in budgeting cycle to set fiscal year goals which aligns with company’s strategic vision; stress-test budget assumptions and formalize action plans to address underlying variances or risks.

- Business Partnering: Collaborate with functional heads to review monthly spend analytics, identify variance and driving corrective actions to ensure expenses remain aligned with established fiscal targets.

- Profitability Analysis: Evaluate actual profitability outcome and perform deep-dive analysis to identify key performance drivers, translating findings into operational action items that capitalize on strengths and mitigate financial risks.

- Business Case Review: Lead P&L assessment on proposed growth initiatives and flight network reconfiguration; perform scenario testing and synthesize financial data into clear executive summaries to guide management strategic decision making.

- Financial Advisory: Provide expert cost analysis for flight network operations, commercial pricing strategies, and new business development initiatives to drive profitable growth.

You will be a great fit if you
- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting or a related discipline, preferably with an MBA and/or CPA/ACCA/CFA.

- Experience: Minimum five years’ relevant working experience

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
- Advanced knowledge of project management and proficiency in Excel usage, Oracle Essbase and SQL

- Capability to use AI tools (e.g. GEMINI, Copilot) for automating data synthesis, summarizing long-form reports, generating initial analytical commentary, building AI-assisted trend-based model would definite be advantage

- Strong sense of responsibility, detail-oriented, business acumen, and solid story-telling communication skillset

- Sound knowledge in financial management analytical tools and investment modelling

- Fluency in both written and spoken English are a must

- Candidates with less experience will be considered for the role of Regional Financial Planning & Analysis Analyst

jobs.title: Manager Corporate Development
jobs.description:
Supports the activities of the corporate development department in managing the efficient formation of business combinations by FedEx Corporation and its affiliates, including acquisitions, joint ventures and equity investments.

Job Description Overview:

FedEx, a global logistics leader with over 400,000 employees worldwide, provides customers and businesses with a broad portfolio of transportation, e-commerce, and business services. We deliver integrated solutions through our flexible, efficient, and intelligent global network.

As Manager of Corporate Development, you will play a key role in shaping the future growth trajectory of FedEx. Reporting to the Staff Director of Corporate Development, you will be responsible for evaluating and executing strategic opportunities — including mergers and acquisitions, equity investments, and joint ventures — that align with our long-term business priorities.

You will collaborate with global, cross-functional teams to assess potential transactions, monitor industry and competitive trends, and identify emerging opportunities and risks. You will support all stages of deal execution, including financial analysis, strategic evaluation, due diligence, and portfolio management, and will prepare materials and recommendations for senior leadership review. You will also help manage relationships with external stakeholders, including potential partners, target companies, investment banks, and advisors.

Essential Functions:

- Reporting to the Director of Corporate Development, this position is responsible for evaluating and executing strategic opportunities — including mergers and acquisitions, equity investments, and joint ventures — that align with our long-term business priorities.
- Collaborate with global, cross-functional teams to assess potential transactions, monitor industry and competitive trends, and identify emerging opportunities and risks.
- Support all stages of deal execution, including financial analysis, strategic evaluation, due diligence, and portfolio management, and prepare materials and recommendations for senior leadership review.
- Manage relationships with external stakeholders, including potential partners, target companies, investment banks, and advisors.
- Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Education:

- Bachelor’s degree/equivalent in finance, business, or related field.
- MBA or equivalent graduate degree strongly preferred.

Minimum Experience:

- Five (5) or more years in mergers and acquisitions, and/or private equity investment or equivalent experience, with demonstrated end-to-end transaction experience. Candidates with fewer years of experience who possess an accelerated track record of successful deal execution and strong financial acumen are also highly encouraged to apply.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

- Strong financial modeling and valuation capabilities, including DCF, comparable company, precedent transaction and accretion/dilution analyses.
- Familiarity with the transportation, logistics, or supply chain tech sectors, including market dynamics and trends.
- Corporate development, corporate strategy, investment banking, private equity, venture capital, and/or management consulting experience is a plus.
- Strong deal structuring and negotiation experience, including review of legal documents such as investment agreements and merger agreements
- Industry competitive intelligence experience
- Excellent interpersonal and communication, with the ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate across teams.
- Proven leadership in cross-functional settings with a track record of driving results.
- Strategic thinking and critical problem-solving capabilities.
- Ability to synthesize complex strategic and financial concepts and details into an executive-level narrative.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Global EBS Governance and Value Management Team
Responsible for executing process quality, controls, and audit governance activities across EBS sub-processes, owning audit methodology, sampling and calibration standards, and defect/RCA-CAPA management, while partnering with cross-functional and vendor stakeholders to strengthen process governance maturity across the region.
Job Title: Senior Analyst – EBS Process Governance, EBS
Global EBS Governance and Value Management Team
Responsible for executing process quality, controls, and audit governance activities across EBS sub-processes, owning audit methodology, sampling and calibration standards, and defect/RCA-CAPA management, while partnering with cross-functional and vendor stakeholders to strengthen process governance maturity across the region.
Essential Duties:
- Execute end-to-end process audits across in-scope EBS sub-processes, ensuring consistent application of scorecards, evidence standards, and quality dimensions.

- Apply and refine risk-based sampling methodologies across processes/sub-processes, including rules for ramp-up, stabilization, and run-rate operations.

- Support calibration sessions and help standardize critical/non-critical error definitions across EBS; assist in resolving escalated audit disputes through fact-based review.

- Own the defect management lifecycle for assigned processes — centralized logging, trend analysis, RCA, CAPA design, containment, and effectiveness validation through to closure.

- Support adherence to internal controls, audit standards, SOX/statutory requirements, and approved operating procedures; assist with audit readiness and remediation tracking.

- Provide process governance support for transitions, migrations, and process changes across EBS, validating readiness criteria and supporting a controlled handoff to steady-state operations.

- Develop scorecards, dashboards, and management reporting connecting audit outcomes to business performance (customer experience, SLA performance, compliance posture).

- Act as a process governance point of contact for EBS process owners and cross-functional/vendor partners; support calibration and quality/governance review forums.

- Identify recurring process gaps and convert insights into SOP updates, control redesign, and audit/reporting automation.

- Coach and mentor junior analysts, supporting their development and consistency of audit approach.

Performs other duties as assigned.
Minimum Education:
Bachelor’s degree/equivalent in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Commerce, Management Information Systems, or a related discipline.
Minimum Experience:
Minimum five (5) years of progressive experience in Process Governance, Quality Audit, Controls, Order to Cash, Accounts Receivable, or Finance Shared Services roles, including experience designing or managing audit frameworks, sampling plans, and RCA/CAPA processes.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
- Demonstrated expertise across audit frameworks, scorecards, sampling methodology, and defect/RCA-CAPA management.

- Strong familiarity with internal controls, SOX or compliance requirements, and process documentation standards.

- Proven ability to influence stakeholders and senior leadership, driving resolution through fact-based, data-driven discussion.

- Strong coaching/mentoring capability with experience guiding junior team members.

- Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills; ability to translate audit findings into business insight.

- Exposure to digital quality monitoring, workflow automation, and analytics-led continuous improvement preferred.

📋 Core Qualifications

Requirement Details

Bachelor’s degree/equivalent in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Commerce, Management Information Systems, or a related discipline.
Experience
Minimum five (5) years of progressive experience in Process Governance, Quality Audit, Controls, Order to Cash, Accounts Receivable, or Finance Shared Services roles, including experience designing or managing audit frameworks, sampling plans, and RCA/CAPA processes.
Certifications (Preferred)
CPA, CA, CIA, CISA, Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, Lean, or equivalent quality/audit certification preferred. Exposure to internal controls or compliance training (e.g., SOX awareness) is a plus. jobs.title: People Operations Intern
jobs.description:
Our People Operations Internship offers undergraduates an exciting opportunity to gain real-world HR experience while supporting the people practices that drive business success. As a People Operations Intern, you will work alongside experienced HR professionals, contribute to meaningful projects, and play a vital role in delivering an exceptional employee experience throughout the employee lifecycle.

Whether you're passionate about HR operations, people analytics, employee experience, or process improvement, this internship will provide valuable exposure and a strong foundation for your future career in Human Resources.
What can you expect?

Employee Lifecycle & HR Operations
- Support key employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, employee movements, and offboarding activities.
- Partner with various stakeholders to support HR operational processes and deliver a positive employee experience.

HR Systems & People Analytics
- Maintain accurate employee data across HR systems and records while ensuring data integrity and confidentiality.
- Generate HR reports, dashboards, and workforce metrics that help drive informed people decisions.
- Support system enhancement initiatives, testing activities, and process automation projects aimed at improving operational efficiency.

Employee Experience & Engagement
- Serve as a trusted support partner by responding to employee inquiries and guiding employees on HR processes and policies.
- Assist in planning and coordinating employee engagement and wellness initiatives.
- Support internal communications and help deliver meaningful employee experiences across the organization.
- Contribute fresh ideas and creative solutions to continuously improve people programs and processes.

Compliance & Continuous Improvement
- Support compliance-related activities by ensuring employee records and documentation are maintained according to company policies and regulatory requirements.
- Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and enhance service delivery within People Operations.
- Participate in special projects that support the ongoing evolution of HR practices and employee experience initiatives.

How will you make your mark?

You will make a meaningful difference by:
- Helping create positive employee experiences from day one through every stage of the employee journey.
- Supporting operational excellence through accurate data management and exceptional service delivery.
- Leveraging data and insights to support better workforce decisions and people initiatives.
- Bringing fresh perspectives, innovative ideas, and a continuous improvement mindset to the People Operations team.
- Contributing to projects that enhance employee engagement, operational efficiency, and business success.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for enthusiastic, curious, and driven individuals who are eager to learn and make an impact.
- Undergraduates who have completed at least two (2) years of their degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Management, or related disciplines.
- Excellent command of written and spoken English.
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a passion for working with people.
- Detail-oriented with the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information professionally.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with an interest in people data and reporting.
- Highly organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.
- A team player who is eager to learn, contribute, and embrace new challenges.
- Familiarity with HR systems, Power BI, Power Automate, or data visualization tools will be an added advantage.
- Minimum internship commitment of 3 to 6 months.

Why This Opportunity Stands Out

- Gain end-to-end exposure to People Operations and the employee lifecycle.
- Work on meaningful projects that create real impact for employees and the business.
- Develop practical skills in HR operations, employee experience, analytics, compliance, and stakeholder management.
- Learn from experienced HR professionals and gain insights into best-in-class people practices.
- Grow your professional network while accelerating your personal and career development.

Join us and kick-start your HR career by helping create an exceptional workplace where people can grow, succeed, and do their best work every day.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with Pharma and MedTech customers.

- Identify opportunities to improve customer experience and strengthen long-term partnerships.
- Work closely with Sales, Solution Design, Finance, Procurement, IT, Quality and other internal teams.

- Identify opportunities to improve productivity, resource utilization, process efficiency and service quality .

- Optimize manpower, equipment, warehouse capacity and other operational resources.
- Lead Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma or other continuous improvement initiatives.
- Identify process bottlenecks and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
- Drive automation, digitization and technology adoption wherever commercially and operationally viable.
